issue: करत वेद विद ब्रह्मा: करत ('making') with वेद.
our reading: Know me as Brahmā, who brings forth the Vedas and knows them.
alternatives: 'I, Brahmā, knower of the Vedas, declare: know this' (करत as 'doing, speaking').

issue: अपूर्णे, literally 'O incomplete one', beside सदपूर्णे.
our reading: O Aparṇā (Pārvatī's name), as the glossary's first sense.

issue: भव-विभूति: भव as 'the world' or 'Śiva'; विभूति as 'riches, splendour' or 'Śiva's sacred ash'.
our reading: full of the world's riches and of bliss (Annapūrṇā as giver of plenty).
alternatives: full of Śiva's glory (or ash) and bliss.

issue: The subject of राज विमुखको राज दिवावै is not named.
our reading: The reading (पाठ, the subject of chaupāī 40 and of chaupāīs 36–38) wins back a kingdom.
alternatives: The Mother gets a kingdom for one deprived of it (the half then shifts to the third person).
